summary:
Implementation plan for the Members screen refinements:
- Consolidating the second pod header into a single unified row (Title on left, search and filters in middle, export on right) without the icon, subtitle, or separation line.
- Removing the fullscreen button from the member pod and adding it to the TopBar profile dropdown menu.
- Replacing the export button with the genuine branded 40px Atrium Button.
- Redesigning the filters view into a centered Apple-style modal sheet with frosted backdrop and Atrium terracotta accents.
